newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER SHOWCASE-FACTS AND FIGURES FOR HEARTS V RANGERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-FACTS AND FIGURES FOR HEARTS V RANGERS.

text.p: Facts and figures for Saturday's Scottish premier division match between Heart of Midlothian and Glasgow Rangers at Tynecastle.
Hearts: Founded in 1874. They have won the Scottish league title four times.
Ground: Tynecastle Park, capacity 16,613. Record number of spectators: 53,396 v Glasgow Rangers, February 13 1932 in the third round of the Scottish Cup.
League record against Rangers last season (Hearts first): 1-4 away, 0-2 home, 3-0 away, 2-0 home
Home kit: Maroon shirt, white shorts, maroon socks with white trim.
Record defeat: 1-8 v Vale of Leven, 1888.
Glasgow Rangers: Founded in 1873. They have won the Scottish league title a record 46 times.
Ground: Ibrox, capacity 50,000. Record number of spectators:
118,567 v Glasgow Celtic, January 2 1939, in the league.
League record against Hearts last season (Rangers first): 4-1 home, 2-0 away, 0-3 home, 0-2 away.
Home kit: Blue shirts, white shorts, black socks with red trim.
